blocks.text: By entering the campus of Kingdom Heights Preparatory School or participating in school-sponsored events, you acknowledge that photography, video recording, and/or audio recording may take place for promotional, educational, or marketing purposes.
Kingdom Heights Preparatory School will not publicly disclose students’ last names or other personal identifying information without prior consent.
If you do not wish for your or your child’s image or voice to be used, please submit a written request to info@khroyals.com prior to your visit or participation.
